newsitem.title: USA: Wallace Computer Q1 EPS above estimates.
newsitem.headline: Wallace Computer Q1 EPS above estimates.

text.p: Wallace Computer Services Inc reported on Thursday first-quarter operating share earnings of $0.48 before takeover expenses versus $0.42 during the same period last year.
It said the earnings were $0.02 per share above analysts' consensus forecasts.
It said first-quarter share net was $0.48 versus $0.37 per share after takeover expenses.
Wallace Computer, in a statement accompanying earnings, "confirmed continued momentum" in its outsourcing program and contract stationer initiative.

"Customer demand for the W.I.N. and Select Services forms management programs continues to be strong," it said, adding that a number of new accounts were signed during the quarter in the heathcare area, indicating Wallace is "making further inroads" into that area.
The company said sales for the first quarter rose three percent to $220.8 million, the highest quarterly sales in its history which occurred despite a price drop in some paper grades.
It also said the impact of LIF0 accounting was "negligible", with a positive swing of about $0.005 per share quarter-over-quarter.
Wallace Computer Services makes and distributes information management products, services and solutions.
